description: Ministerium für Umwelt, Klima, Mobilität, Agrar und Verbraucherschutz: inland waterway datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerium für Umwelt, Klima, Mobilität, Agrar und Verbraucherschutz. Coverage: Ministerium für Umwelt, Klima, Mobilität, Agrar und Verbraucherschutz. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about inland waterway; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Landesplanung - LEP Umwelt 2004 SB Binnenschifffahrt BB; Landesentwicklungsplan Saarland 2030 - Standortbereiche für Binnenschi; LEP Umwelt 2004 Standortbereiche für Binnenschifffahrt Saarland; LEP Umwelt 2004 Wasserstrassenverbindungen Saarland. Formats seen: WMS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
